name: Than Winter Came
source:
Guide a young protagonist named MJ on a  journey to meet a friend.  You open your eyes and you are-?? A? WHAT!? 

[From [url=https://yanagami.itch.io/than-winter-came]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
引导年轻的主人公MJ踏上一段去见朋友的旅程。你睁开眼，发现自己是——？？是个…什么？！

（来源：[url=https://yanagami.itch.io/than-winter-came]itch.io[/url]）
